story: Toyota has stepped up lobbying to preserve its investments in hybrids, hydrogen
text: 'According to the US Department of Energy, less than 5 per cent of lithium-ion batteries — demand for which is set to boom as carmakers such as Mercedes lay out goals to go “all-electric” — are currently recycled.' [LINK] Unless battery reuse is made viable there is no path forward for any future mass market in EV's. [LINK] Given that gasoline continues to easily provide the most bang for the buck/weight/volume IMO hybrids are the logical way forward until grids are recreated to cater to Small Nuclear Reactors and rewired to handle volume electrical delivery.
